Talk about your anger management techniques.

When I was a lot younger my go to method was to quickly punch the nearest object until it broke, but as I grew older I realized that all I really need to do is think about what made me angry. Eventually i'll see how insignificant the inciting incident was in the long run and get over it.
When someone or something makes you angry how do you get over it?

Reminds me of that iCarly clip.

"Oh, he's a cute little cannibal." "Yes. It worries me."
Bottle it up until it shaves another day off my life :/

In one word: distraction. I'll play video games, go for walk, watch something funny on Netflix... whatever it takes to lighten the mood a little. It's a lot easier to let go and move on when the thing (or person) that pissed me off isn't my main focus anymore.

This works really well for dealing with strong short term emotions, as most wear off after 30 minutes if you aren't feeding that emotion. With a cooler head, you can then act appropriately instead of out of pure emotion.
Depending on the situation either yell something like "fuck you, you stupid cunt" or give them the fuck your're stupid look and shake my head. Then forget about it and move on.

I listen to limp bizkit's break stuff when I'm angry.

Edit: link to the song https://youtu.be/cCslC3ykX-U

If someone is making me angry, I start to contemplate on what could make said person act in such a strange way (insults, snarky comments, etc.) Then I come to the conclusion they must be going through a tough time, or having an unusual outburst that isn't normal regarding their typical behavior. Then I empathize a bit more, tell them I hope they feel better, and that everyone goes through emotions like this at one point or another, then I have no problems or resentments towards that person anymore.

When I get really really angry, however, like a mad berserk rage on the verge of potentially commiting homicide, I isolate myself. I turn on some soft acoustic songs and paint. Or else I take a nap and wake up in a much more calm state. (:

Just try and remind myself how small me and my problems are. And that I'm just walking thinking carbon and none of this will matter eventually. So its better to enjoy the statistical anomoly that is our existence than spend this time pissed off.

Tl;Dr : Perspective
